MEET SHIVA EXIM

A direct conversation.
A considered trade.

Established in 2018, Shiva Exim is an agricultural export and import business based in Mehsana, Gujarat. Our portfolio brings together Indian spices, agricultural seeds, grains and selected import products.

Whether you are a buyer seeking Indian products or a supplier exploring the Indian market, share your requirements with us.
